name: Significance-Aware Pruning
aliases: Pruning based on accumulated alpha blending coefficients
definition: A pruning strategy that evaluates a Gaussian's contribution to scene reconstruction by accumulating alpha blending coefficients ($w_k$) over all pixels and views between densification steps, sparing Gaussians with low opacity but high significance.
summary: Significance-Aware Pruning removes redundant 3D Gaussians by evaluating their accumulated alpha blending contributions to rendered pixels, distinguishing visually critical primitives from those that are geometrically large but insignificant.
